title: Self-similar blow-up solutions of $d$-dimensional incompressible Euler equations with $C^{1,\left(1-2/d\right)-}$ velocity
summary: We investigate self-similar blow-up solutions to the $d$-dimensional axisymmetric incompressible Euler equations without swirl for $d\ge 3$. For any $α\in(0, α_d)$ with $α_d=1-2/d$, we construct a self-similar blow-up solution whose initial velocity field satisfies $u_0\in C^{1,α}_{\rm loc}(\mathbb R^d)\cap C^\infty(\mathbb R^d\setminus\{0\})$. Our construction relies on a fixed-point argument formulated for the self-similar profile equations, which form a coupled elliptic-transport system.
